scope: Prespecified before independent TraceLab performance; model-specific transfer assessment, not production traffic replay
linear_state_dtype: float32; preserve actual existing configuration, no precision shortcuts
context_scaling_rule: Multiply normal token capacity, prompt cap and source context scale by4 to preserve relative KV pressure; each policy within a comparison remains identical. Synthetic lengths and waits/caps are reported.
freeze_rule: Finish all4 CacheWise validation cases before model-specific freeze. Default3s. Compare30s only on CacheWise if actual timing/counters identify expiry before otherwise reusable fast continuations; preserve all3s outcomes and document any choice before any hybrid TraceLab test. Never tune on independent test performance.
kernel_guard: Persist existing tilelang-v10 cache. All starts/warmups precede timing. Reject and preserve a whole phase containing logged timed TileLang compilation; warm missing kernels outside timing before repeating complete phase.
functional_checks: Real echo tool/result loops, actual resumable state checkpoints under pressure, stable input boundary, per-rank numeric idle coverage/hint consistency when feasible; stronger cached-prefix retrieval smoke desirable. Controlled probe times are diagnostic, never production speed claims.
limits: Shared host CPU/I/O, isolated selected GPUs, no original raw text or finish reasons in metadata, 3seeds provide limited descriptive bootstrap uncertainty, all regressions/cohorts retained.
scheduling: FIFO-feasible heads first, cached backfill only for blocked head

benchmark_repair.previous_attempt: v17 independent phase stopped after six matching pairs and one failed pair; full phase excluded
benchmark_repair.reason: v17 punctuation drift; v18 constrained long ordinary output exceeded heuristic budget before any independent inference; full incomplete phases excluded
benchmark_repair.ordinary_output: json-string exact enum schema, actual tokenizer plus literal byte/EOS budget; both short and shaped replies
benchmark_repair.revalidation: Repeat all fixed validation cases before complete independent rerun; no case/seed/parameter selection using independent performance
